versions.changelog: Release 1.1.1 from the GitHub source. Updates the ClawHub summary/description to Chinese while keeping the full AgentSkills package aligned with GitHub.

Release 1.1.0 from the GitHub source. Restores the full AgentSkills package with SKILL.md, references, scripts, agents/openai.yaml, README, and plugin metadata so ClawHub matches the GitHub/SkillHub implementation.

No file changes were detected for version 1.0.3.

- No updates to features, behavior, or documentation were made in this release.
- Skill logic and description remain unchanged.

- Updated the skill name and documentation to Chinese ("高考志愿填报助手") for improved clarity and localization.
- No changes to workflow or functionality; only documentation language was updated.
- All usage triggers, principles, and examples remain available in both Chinese and English descriptions.

- Skill version 1.0.1 is a minor update.
- Removed the skill documentation file (skill-card.md) for simplification.
- No changes to the assistant's core functionality or guidance workflow.
- No impact on user experience or response logic.

Gaokao Application Assistant initial release:

- Provides structured, explainable college shortlist recommendations for mainland China Gaokao applicants.
- Uses rank-first analysis and three-band (safe/match/reach) risk stratification.
- Requires users to verify all suggestions via official sources and emphasizes planning/not guarantee.
- Supports major and region preferences, subject-type handling, and human-review checkpoints.
- Triggers on specific phrases related to Gaokao application help.
